lines.text: Hey man, what kept you so long?
If you're looking for the key, I've got it right here.
I did get the key, but the Master Reaverbot ate it.
I asked him real nice-like if he'd give it back to me,
but he's not the friendly type, you know what I mean?
You can have the key, if you can get it back from him.
I mean, there's three more keys.
Klaymoor will probably figure out a way to get them, so it's no skin off my nose.
